Finite checks do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: This is an all-size natural graph-family recurrence classification. The result uncovers a precise square-board-only omission from otherwise entire partial matching strata, yields computable explicit binomial sums for every labelled primitive two-cycle census, and proves Q_{2,b}=2^b-1 for b>=3. These are dynamical graph invariants not determined by the generic period-two bound or the known maximal-independent-set fixed-point identification.
